title: Preference & Cost-Aware Steering explainer kit and map visuals for quickstart
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Deliver a compact explainer kit for the Console quickstart and docs that shows how regional preference and cost-aware steering affect latency and unit cost. Deliverables: 1) a hero illustration (wide) for docs, 2) four micro-diagrams that explain steering decisions (preference, latency threshold, fallback corridors, cost override), 3) interactive map tile comps (3 zoom states) showing latency bands + cost contours, and 4) production-ready console screenshots with callouts for the policy UI. The visuals must be accessible (WCAG AA color contrast), use our system icons, and be export-friendly for SVG/PNG. Use data-driven thresholds but keep the kit suitable for static docs and a later interactive prototype.
